interpretation.authority: All three are finite R13 rectangle direct runs with full_dtn_status=FULL_DTN_NOT_VERIFIED and AUTHORITY_LIMITED classification. The horizontal Ht metric remains a diagnostic, and the canonical pillar sidewall trace gate remains NOT_MEASURED_AS_CANONICAL_HCURL_TRACE_GATE.
interpretation.independent_port_residual: A production witness verifies actual top traction/modal RHS, the finalized 612-mode MPC use, q28 and exact phase/pairing facts. No separately recomputed port-equation projection residual was available without another factor/action diagnostic; therefore that remains NOT_RUN.
interpretation.pm4_amplitude: The top (m=±4,n=0,p) modes are stored non-propagating and non-power-carrying. Y2 boundary-plane magnitude is about 1.4867e-3 per mode versus about 4.28e-7 (Y) and 4.38e-7 (Y3); pair differences dominate roughly 99.9918% of the Y↔Y2 and Y2↔Y3 all-612 boundary-amplitude delta squared. Their per-mode R/T are zero in these records.
interpretation.raw_vs_boundary: For these modes beta=+0.5025891902i and top reference z=130nm; the exact stored boundary_phase magnitude is 4.2138342045e-29 and raw_outgoing*boundary_phase reproduces the boundary amplitude exactly in the saved JSON. The enormous raw coefficient is the reference-plane exponential scaling of a decaying evanescent mode. Because the phase is identical across meshes, it explains the raw scale but does not remove the Y2 boundary-amplitude outlier; its numerical cause remains unresolved.
interpretation.y_trend: Y2-to-Y3 adjacent R00_s delta falls below 1e-6, while Y-to-Y2 exceeded it; the Y2-to-Y3 horizontal H_t sample difference remains above 1e-4. Y-to-Y3 overall shows R00_s difference >1e-6 but its horizontal H_t sample is small. These are reported separately; no single result is called convergence.

provenance.new_pairwise_comparisons: derived directly from saved per-case mode JSON and the just-generated same-coordinate field comparison summaries; artifact hashes recorded under cases.

port_reference_identity.amplitude_convention: auxiliary unknown a_j is the total-field port projection. top outgoing amplitude = a_j - incident_projection_j; bottom outgoing amplitude = a_j. Power uses boundary-plane outgoing amplitude after applying boundary_phase.
port_reference_identity.dtn_modal_reference: top=physical_z_max; bottom=physical_z_min; bottom lossy power uses boundary-plane phase attenuation
port_reference_identity.raw_vs_boundary_note: Raw outgoing coefficients and boundary-plane phased amplitudes are both retained. The raw coefficients include complex-beta reference-plane exponential scaling; physical port power is computed from the boundary-plane amplitude. The references and per-mode phase factors are identical between Y and Y2.

same_coordinate_field_comparison.note: Stored reference samples are 5x64x40 points; the two tangential reference planes are horizontal z=10/110nm with x/y components. They are not pillar sidewalls or the z=0/120 material interfaces, and are not a canonical H(curl) sidewall trace gate.
